summary: Russia launched a large-scale drone and missile attack across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, and Odesa, causing casualties and infrastructure damage. Ukrainian air defense intercepted some projectiles while multiple regions reported ongoing attacks. Zelenskyy announced Ukraine will develop drones with ranges up to 10,000 kilometers and confirmed continuation of martial law and mobilization until October 2026.
key_points: Russia launched over 90 attack drones including more than a third being cruise missiles across multiple Ukrainian regions from July 24, 2026, with air defenses intercepting some projectiles (Source: @kpszsu/69965).
Two Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles struck Kyiv region at approximately 11:30, killing six people and injuring dozens, with one missile intercepted by air defense (Source: @kpszsu/69965).
Russian cruise missiles struck a private defense technology exhibition near Kyiv killing at least 10 people, with additional casualties reported at the site (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31895).
Ukrainian naval forces received NATO command authority for mine countermeasures during Sea Breeze 2026 exercises, achieving NATO Evaluation Level 2 certification (Source: @UkraineNow/82881).
Russia deployed 35 Iskander-M ballistic missiles in Bryansk region and 5 hypersonic missiles in Kursk region, with additional Su-34 bomber threat detected near Crimea (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69370).

Zelenskyy announced Ukraine will develop drones with ranges increasing from 3,000km currently to 10,000km by next year, while extending martial law and mobilization until October 2026 (Source: @UkraineNow/82908).
Poland proposed joint US-Ukraine Patriot missile production and establishment of a service center for missile systems to address US security concerns (Source: @UkraineNow/82875).

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted a major multi-domain attack across Ukraine using over 90 drones and ballistic missiles, killing at least 10 people at a defense exhibition near Kyiv and six others in separate strikes. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted one Iskander missile while suffering significant infrastructure damage across Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, and Odesa regions. President Zelenskyy announced extension of martial law until October 2026 and revealed plans to develop drones with 10,000km range capability.
ukraine: Russia launched over 90 attack drones across Ukraine on July 24, 2026, with more than a third being cruise missiles. Air defense forces intercepted one Iskander-M ballistic missile while two others struck Bucha district on Kyiv region, killing six people and injuring dozens (Source: @kpszsu/69965).

A Russian cruise missile strike on a private defense technology exhibition near Kyiv killed at least 10 people, according to footage from the strike site. The attack targeted a venue organized by a private manufacturers association, though Brave1 was not involved as organizer or partner (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31895).

President Zelenskyy signed decrees extending martial law and general mobilization for 90 days starting August 2, 2026, through October 31, 2026. He emphasized prioritizing human lives and potential peace negotiations over prolonged combat operations (Source: @UkraineNow/82880).

Ukrainian Navy's 1st Mine Countermeasures Division successfully completed NATO Evaluation Level 2 assessment during Sea Breeze 2026 exercises, becoming the first Ukrainian unit authorized to command NATO multinational forces for mine warfare operations (Source: @UkraineNow/82881).

Russia struck Slavyansk with two guided aerial bombs, killing five people and wounding nine others. The attack damaged 10 private residential buildings, a Latvian honorary consulate building, and nearby vehicles (Source: @UkraineNow/82909).
russia: Russian forces maintain 35 Iskander-M ballistic missiles in Bryansk region and 5 hypersonic missiles in Kursk region, according to monitoring sources. These systems pose continued threat to Ukrainian infrastructure and population centers (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69370).

Russia deployed Su-34 bomber aircraft toward Crimea carrying potential Kh-59 cruise missiles, triggering air raid alerts. The aircraft represents ongoing aerial threat capability from Russian Aerospace Forces (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69333).

Russian military command announced retaliatory policy of executing one American service member for each Iranian killed in US strikes. This escalation represents heightened rhetoric in ongoing tensions between the two nations (Source: @tass_agency/386918).

Russian central bank governor Elvira Nabiullina reported inflationary pressures from fuel price increases spreading to broader goods and services sectors. The economic impact affects domestic stability amid ongoing military operations (Source: @tass_agency/386888).
eastern_front: Russian forces continue launching attack drones toward Donetsk region from eastern directions, maintaining pressure on Ukrainian positions along the contact line. Multiple drone groups have been detected moving toward key urban centers (Source: @kpszsu/69953).

Ukrainian air defense reported active drone activity in Sumy and Kharkiv regions from northern approaches throughout the day. Attack drones and reconnaissance assets were tracked moving toward civilian and military targets (Source: @kpszsu/69977).

Russian forces conducted coordinated strikes using cruise missiles and guided aerial bombs against Kharkiv region infrastructure. A Novaya Pochta facility in Izium was hit with three guided aerial bombs, damaging residential areas and power lines (Source: @UkraineNow/82876).

Donetsk regional prosecutors confirmed Russian forces executed a captured Ukrainian soldier near Yalta village in Kommarska community on July 13. The military-political officer gave execution order after interrogation, with another soldier carrying out the shooting (Source: @UkraineNow/82888).
northern_front: Russian air defense systems shot down two Ukrainian military personnel in Bryansk region during a training flight that failed to return. Fourteen additional personnel sustained injuries in the incident near the airfield (Source: @eRadarrua/102481).

Monitoring sources detected possible repeat ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region within the next few hours. Air defense systems remain on high alert status throughout northern Ukraine (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69362).

Ukrainian air defense tracked multiple attack drones approaching Sumy region from northern directions. Reconnaissance and cruise missile groups were identified moving toward defensive positions (Source: @eRadarrua/102500).

Chernihiv region experienced attack drone activity from northern approaches, with one group detected moving toward Kremenchug. Air raid sirens activated across northern Ukraine border regions (Source: @eRadarrua/102503).
southern_front: Russia launched two Onyx anti-ship cruise missiles from Crimea against Odesa region at approximately 11:45 on July 24. Ukrainian air defense successfully intercepted both projectiles before reaching their targets (Source: @kpszsu/69965).

Three cruise missile groups were detected moving from Dnipro region toward Kirovohrad region, representing continued southern axis pressure. Air defense systems tracked the projectiles throughout their flight paths (Source: @kpszsu/69950).

Odesa region experienced multiple attack drone incursions from the Black Sea direction. Additional cruise missile groups were detected moving northward from eastern Kherson region positions (Source: @kpszsu/69976).

Allseeds, one of the largest plant oil producers and exporters, suspended operations on Odesa region due to Russian attacks. The company cited extremely high risks to employee safety and facility infrastructure (Source: @UkraineNow/82901).
air_war: Ukrainian air defense intercepted one Iskander-M ballistic missile during Russian attack on Kyiv region at 11:30 on July 24. Two additional missiles struck Bucha district, causing civilian casualties and infrastructure damage (Source: @kpszsu/69965).

Romanian Air Force F-16 fighter aircraft shot down an unidentified drone that entered Romanian airspace near the Ukrainian border. The incident occurred around 11:00 in an unpopulated area near Odesa region (Source: @UkraineNow/82879).

Russian Su-34 fullback bomber aircraft were detected moving toward Crimea carrying potential Kh-59 cruise missiles. The aircraft pose ongoing aerial threat to Ukrainian southern regions and maritime approaches (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69333).

Over 90 attack drones including cruise missile variants were tracked in Ukrainian airspace during the July 24 engagement. More than one third of these were classified as cruise missile systems requiring advanced interception protocols (Source: @kpszsu/69965).
key_developments: Russia launched coordinated attack using over 90 drones and ballistic missiles across Ukraine on July 24, 2026, killing at least 16 people including 10 at a defense exhibition near Kyiv and six in separate strikes (Source: @kpszsu/69965).

Two Iskander-M ballistic missiles struck Bucha district on Kyiv region at approximately 11:30, with Ukrainian air defense intercepting one of three launched missiles. Casualties include six confirmed deaths and dozens injured (Source: @kpszsu/69965).

President Zelenskyy signed decrees extending martial law and general mobilization for 90 days through October 31, 2026, emphasizing focus on preserving human life over prolonged combat operations (Source: @UkraineNow/82880).

Ukrainian Navy achieved NATO Evaluation Level 2 certification for mine countermeasures during Sea Breeze 2026, becoming first Ukrainian unit authorized to command NATO multinational forces in maritime operations (Source: @UkraineNow/82881).

Russia maintains 35 Iskander-M ballistic missiles in Bryansk region and 5 hypersonic missiles in Kursk region, with Su-34 bomber threat detected near Crimea carrying potential Kh-59 cruise missiles (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69370).

Poland proposed joint US-Ukraine Patriot missile production and service center establishment to address American security concerns regarding manufacturing on Ukrainian territory (Source: @UkraineNow/82875).

Russian forces executed captured Ukrainian soldier in Donetsk region after interrogation, with military-political officer ordering execution and another soldier carrying out shooting near Yalta village (Source: @UkraineNow/82888).
sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces maintain significant offensive capability with 35 Iskander-M ballistic missiles positioned in Bryansk region and 5 hypersonic missiles in Kursk region, presenting ongoing existential threat to Ukrainian population centers. The July 24 multi-domain attack demonstrated Russia's capacity to simultaneously engage targets across all Ukrainian regions using over 90 drones and cruise missiles. Ukrainian air defense systems successfully intercepted key projectiles but suffered penetrations resulting in civilian casualties, indicating persistent vulnerability despite defensive improvements. Russian aerial assets including Su-34 bombers continue operating near Crimea with potential Kh-59 cruise missile payloads threatening southern Ukraine and Odesa port facilities. The execution of captured Ukrainian soldiers represents escalation in violation of international humanitarian law and suggests deteriorating adherence to prisoner treatment protocols.
sections.regional_response: Polish defense officials proposed joint US-Ukraine Patriot missile production to address American security concerns about manufacturing on Ukrainian territory, potentially strengthening NATO supply chains for critical air defense systems. Romanian Air Force F-16 aircraft shot down an unidentified drone that breached Romanian airspace near the Ukrainian border, demonstrating NATO's commitment to defending allied territory from spillover attacks. The US Senate is preparing to vote on comprehensive sanctions legislation against Russia with potential bipartisan support from over 60 co-sponsors, indicating renewed congressional focus on punitive measures. European allies continue monitoring Russian economic resilience despite extensive sanctions, with central bank officials reporting inflationary pressures from energy price increases affecting broader consumer markets.
sections.intelligence_notes: President Zelenskyy announced Ukraine will develop drones with ranges increasing from 3,000km currently to 10,000km by next year, representing significant advancement in long-range strike capability that could challenge Russian interior regions. Zelenskyy also revealed improved relations with former US President Trump following Vatican meeting, suggesting potential diplomatic channels for future negotiations despite current escalation. Russian military bloggers report ongoing logistical challenges with Wildberries warehouse fires in St. Petersburg and Simferopol following Ukrainian drone attacks, indicating vulnerability of commercial infrastructure to asymmetric warfare tactics. The execution of Ukrainian prisoners of war in Donetsk region was documented by regional prosecutors, providing evidence for potential war crimes investigations at international tribunals. Monitoring sources indicate Russian forces are reinforcing positions in preparation for continued offensive operations, with particular emphasis on Bryansk and Kursk border regions for potential cross-border strikes.
